Q1: Which branch should this fix land on, given that the default branch already has the corrected template?
Choices:
A. Target PR #6563's head branch. Treat the issue as declaring `Integration branch: ai/issue-6557` and open the fix PR into it, editing only `prompts/_templates/mode-judge-unblock.txt` to match that branch's active `prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt`. Applies only if PR #6563 is still open. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Treat the issue as already done on the default branch and close it with no code change. Choose this if PR #6563 is already merged or closed, or if fixing that branch is left to its own review/autofix loop.
C. Target `ai/issue-6557`, but bring the default branch into it instead: merge the default branch so the branch picks up #6812's template fix and regression test. This replaces a hand edit of the template.
**Note:** A and C both need PR #6563 to be open. If it is merged or closed, only B applies.
